AI.method: 采用逐步环境空气暴露制备溶液处理Te纳米颗粒 ensemble，结合结构与光谱表征分析其元素Te、α-TeO2及含羟基表面物种；并制备光电探测器测试405、532和1550 nm响应及1550 nm瞬态性能。
AI.result: 器件在405、532和1550 nm最大响应度分别为10.1、14.4和8.5 mA/W；1550 nm下上升/下降时间为17.7/40.2 s，估计散粒噪声限制比探测率为1.3×10^6 Jones。
AI.conclusion: 逐步环境空气氧化可获得较强制空气氧化更低的氧化Te相对占比，表明控制表面氧化对平衡颗粒间电荷传输和抑制暗电流至关重要，为溶液法Te基短波红外光电探测器提供思路。

title: Hidden memory above the Neel temperature programs antiferromagnetic order in Cr2O3
summary: Control of antiferromagnetic order is central to magnetoelectric and antiferromagnetic spintronic devices. In the prototypical magnetoelectric antiferromagnet Cr2O3, domains are conventionally selected by simultaneous application of electric and magnetic fields during cooling through the Neel temperature (T_N) or at a fixed temperature below T_N. Here, we show that antiferromagnetic order can instead be programmed by electric-field conditioning entirely in the paramagnetic state above T_N. By measuring the magnetoelectric coefficient (alpha_zz) of bulk Cr2O3 crystals under different thermal and field histories, we find that a sufficiently large electric field above T_N establishes a reversible state that persists after the field is removed. Subsequent magnetic-field cooling with no applied electric field produces a single-domain state with the opposite Neel-vector orientation from conventional magnetoelectric field cooling. The electrically induced state can be reversibly written, erased, and allowed to relax at high temperatures, demonstrating a long-lived internal electric bias that governs domain selection. The observed behavior is consistent with a metastable surface-associated polar state that may generate this internal bias. These results reveal an unexpected coupling between electrically programmed memory and antiferromagnetic domain formation in Cr2O3.

AI.tldr: 在Cr2O3顺磁相（T_N以上）施加足够大电场可写入可逆、长寿命的内部电偏置；随后在零电场下进行磁场冷却，会形成与常规磁电场冷却相反取向的反铁磁单畴。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁序调控是磁电和反铁磁自旋电子器件的核心；传统Cr2O3畴选择需在冷却通过T_N时或T_N以下同时施加电场和磁场，作者希望探索无需在有序相中同时加场的调控方式。
AI.method: 测量块体Cr2O3在不同热历史和场历史下的磁电系数α_zz；先在T_N以上仅用电场条件化，再撤去电场并进行无电场磁场冷却；同时测试该电致状态的写入、擦除及高温弛豫行为。
AI.result: T_N以上足够大的电场可建立一个撤场后仍保留的可逆状态；后续无电场磁场冷却产生单畴，且奈尔矢量取向与常规磁电场冷却相反；该电致状态可重复写入、擦除并在高温下弛豫，表现为长寿命内部电偏置，并与亚稳表面相关极性态一致。
AI.conclusion: 发现Cr2O3中电编程记忆与反铁磁畴形成之间存在意外耦合，证明可在顺磁相通过电场预设内部偏置来反向选择反铁磁单畴，为反铁磁序的非传统调控提供新途径。

title: A Transport-Constrained Gradient-Flow Description of Continuum Dislocation Dynamics
summary:
Gradient flow frameworks are fundamental to numerous models of defect and microstructure evolution. This work develops a gradient flow formulation for continuum dislocation dynamics, with the key distinction that the admissible rates are transport-constrained. Using the dislocation density and compatible slip fields as the primary state variables, their admissible rates are restricted by geometric conservation laws. The corresponding transport velocities are then selected variationally through a constrained Onsager principle. The resulting model has both a variational gradient flow structure and consistency with the geometric dislocation conservation statement; existing models of dislocation evolution typically have either one or the other feature.
  This thermodynamic structure provides a dislocation driving force that includes elastic stress contributions -- corresponding to the classical Peach--Koehler force -- as well as contributions from the core and nonconvex lattice energies. A simplified version of the model is used to study the energetics and dynamics of an opposite-sign dislocation pair. The lattice energy keeps the cores compact, and an external applied shear either assists annihilation or, above a threshold, separates the pair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受输运约束的连续位错动力学梯度流框架：以位错密度和相容滑移场为状态变量，用几何守恒律约束容许速率，并通过约束Onsager原理变分选取输运速度；模型同时具备变分梯度流结构与几何位错守恒一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有位错演化模型通常只具备变分梯度流结构或几何守恒一致性之一，缺乏同时满足二者且适用于缺陷/微结构演化的热力学框架。
AI.method: 采用位错密度与相容滑移场作为主状态变量，以几何守恒律限制容许速率；通过约束Onsager原理选择输运速度，构造受输运约束的梯度流。所得驱动力包含弹性应力贡献（经典Peach--Koehler力）以及核心能和非凸晶格能贡献；并用简化模型研究反号位错对的能量学与动力学。
AI.result: 模型同时具有变分梯度流结构和与几何位错守恒陈述的一致性。简化分析表明：晶格能使位错核心保持紧致；外加剪切可辅助反号位错对湮灭，或在超过阈值时使其分离。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为连续位错动力学提供了热力学一致、受输运约束的梯度流表述，统一了变分梯度流与几何守恒特征，并可用于分析位错对的能量与演化行为。

title: Atomically abrupt sp-sp$^2$ all-carbon heterojunction preserving the electronic identity of constituent allotropes
summary: Covalently integrating distinct carbon allotropes with atomic precision remains, to date, elusive, despite the clear advantage of combining complementary functionalities while preserving their electronic identities. Here, we realize an all-carbon lateral heterojunction combining ($sp^2$) armchair graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) and $sp$-$sp^2$ hydrogenated graphdiyne (hGDY) on Au(111) through Fe-mediated hierarchical on-surface synthesis. Low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy combined with density-functional theory reveal an atomically abrupt (<0.5 nm), asymmetric type-I interface. Redistribution of an edge-localized GNR state onto the first hGDY unit demonstrates local electronic continuity, whereas their characteristic electronic structures re-emerge immediately beyond the interface. Calculations further indicate that heterojunction formation weakens the interaction of both constituents with the underlying Au(111) substrate, widening their gaps and reducing adsorption-induced interfacial polarization. These results establish lateral covalent integration as a route to engineer atomically defined electronic interfaces and substrate coupling in all-carbon nanostructures.

AI.tldr: 该工作在Au(111)上通过Fe介导的层级表面合成，制备了由扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（GNR）与氢化石墨二炔（hGDY）共价连接的全碳横向异质结，并揭示其原子级 abrupt、非对称type-I界面及局域电子连续性和衬底耦合调控。
AI.motivation: 将不同碳同素异形体以原子精度共价集成，有望结合互补功能并保持各自电子特性，但此前难以实现。
AI.method: 采用Fe介导的层级 on-surface synthesis 在Au(111)上构建sp2扶手椅GNR与sp-sp2 hGDY的全碳横向异质结；结合低温扫描隧道显微镜/谱（STM/STS）与密度泛函理论（DFT）表征界面结构与电子性质。
AI.result: 发现原子级陡峭（<0.5 nm）的非对称type-I界面；GNR的边缘局域态可扩展到第一个hGDY单元，显示局域电子连续性，而界面之后两者特征电子结构迅速恢复；计算表明异质结形成削弱两组分与Au(111)的相互作用，使带隙展宽并降低吸附诱导的界面极化。
AI.conclusion: 横向共价集成可作为在全碳纳米结构中工程化原子级定义电子界面及调控衬底耦合的途径。

title: Fabrication and Characterization of Flexible In2O3 Thin-Film Transistors on Mica Substrates
summary: Flexible oxide-semiconductor thin-film transistors (TFTs) with high field-effect mobility (uFE > 70 cm^2/Vs) are required for next-generation flexible displays. Polycrystalline In2O3-based TFTs are promising candidates; however, conventional flexible substrates such as plastics are not suitable because their fabrication typically requires relatively high temperatures (~350 deg.C). In this study, we used mica as a flexible substrate to fabricate polycrystalline In2O3-based TFTs, motivated by previous demonstrations of crystalline oxide growth on mica. The resulting TFTs exhibited a uFE of approximately 75 cm^2/Vs. The devices maintained gate-modulated operation after 10^3 flex-out bending cycles at a 5 mm radius, whereas flex-in cycling caused early electrical failure, likely due to In2O3 film degradation. The TFTs also operated normally after exposure to 85 deg.C and 40% relative humidity for one day. These results demonstrate that mica substrates enable high-mobility, flex-out-compatible In2O3-based TFTs.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用云母作为柔性衬底，制备了高迁移率多晶In2O3基薄膜晶体管，uFE约75 cm^2/Vs，并验证了其耐弯折和环境稳定性。
AI.motivation: 下一代柔性显示需要uFE>70 cm^2/Vs的柔性氧化物半导体TFT，但塑料衬底难以承受多晶In2O3制备所需约350°C的高温，因此需寻找耐高温柔性衬底。
AI.method: 以云母为柔性衬底，基于此前在云母上生长结晶氧化物的思路，制备多晶In2O3基TFT，并测试电学性能、5 mm半径下10^3次弯曲循环及85°C/40% RH环境稳定性。
AI.result: 器件uFE约75 cm^2/Vs；经10^3次flex-out弯曲后仍保持栅极调制工作，而flex-in循环导致早期电失效，可能与In2O3薄膜退化有关；在85°C、40% RH下暴露一天后仍正常工作。
AI.conclusion: 云母衬底可实现高迁移率、耐flex-out弯折的In2O3基TFT，为柔性显示提供有前景的技术路径。

title: Multifractality in sputtered crystalline and amorphous transition metal nitride thin films
summary: In this work, we present evidence for multifractal growth in Titanium and Niobium nitride thin films on different substrates. Self-similar multifractal structures such as dendrites and multi-branched snowflake-like structures are reported. The fractal dimensions are controlled by a combination of processing parameters and conditions at the film-substrate interface. Significantly, fractal growth is observed not only in crystalline films on crystalline and amorphous substrates but also on amorphous films on crystalline substrates. The 2D Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (2D MFDFA) carried out on the scanning electron micrographs, clearly reveals the multifractal nature of the nitride thin films. The statistical moments were varied between -5 to +5. The Hausdorff dimensions for the TiN films are in the range of 1.65 to 1.79 while it is 1.64 to 1.74 for the NbN thin films. It is proposed that the observed multifractality is due to a competition between morphological instabilities and Diffusion-Limited Aggregation

AI.tldr: 该文报道TiN和NbN薄膜在不同衬底上出现由工艺参数和膜-衬底界面条件控制的多重分形生长，并用2D MFDFA证实其多重分形特征。
AI.motivation: 探究氮化物薄膜中枝晶、多分支雪花状等自相似分形结构的形成及其受制备条件和界面条件调控的机制。
AI.method: 在不同衬底上制备TiN和NbN薄膜，利用扫描电镜观察形貌，并对SEM图像进行二维多重分形去趋势波动分析（2D MFDFA），统计矩取-5至+5，计算Hausdorff维数。
AI.result: 观察到TiN和NbN薄膜的枝晶及多分支雪花状多重分形结构；TiN的Hausdorff维数为1.65–1.79，NbN为1.64–1.74；分形生长不仅出现在晶态衬底上的晶态膜，也出现在非晶衬底上的晶态膜以及晶态衬底上的非晶膜，且分形维数受工艺参数和膜-衬底界面条件共同控制。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出观测到的多重分形性源于形貌不稳定性与扩散限制聚集（DLA）之间的竞争。

title: Dopant Cluster Engineering for Tunable Room-Temperature Ferromagnetism in 2D Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
summary: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (2D-TMDs) offer a promising platform for realizing dilute magnetic semiconductors. However, simultaneously achieving large magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) and high Curie temperature (T$_\text{c}$) remains a major challenge. In this work, we employ DFT+U to systematically investigate the thermodynamic stability and magnetic properties of 2D-MoSe$_2$ and 2D-WSe$_2$ doped with transition metal atoms. We found that the paired dopant configurations are more stable than previously attributed isolated dopants. Despite their nearly identical crystal structures, 2D-MoSe$_2$ and 2D-WSe$_2$ show contrasting properties upon doping. All paired dopants in 2D-MoSe$_2$ exhibit long-range ferromagnetic coupling (FMC) primarily due to carrier-mediated exchange interactions, whereas those in 2D-WSe$_2$ show weak exchange coupling. Interestingly, 2Mn$_\text{2W}$ shows a transition from less stable antiferromagnetic coupling (AFMC) in the short range to highly stable FMC in the long-range. The combined effect of spin-orbit coupling, exchange interactions, and orbital hybridization gives rise to a large MAE with maximum in-plane values of $-$3.5 meV for 2V$_\text{2Mo}$ and $-$3.2 meV for 2Mn$_\text{2W}$. Monte Carlo simulations estimate T$_\text{c}$ $\simeq$ 440 K for 2Fe$_\text{2Mo}$ and ensure its high-temperature stability in 2D-MoSe$_2$. Our results establish dopant clustering as an effective route to engineer high-temperature ferromagnetism in 2D-TMDs and highlight their potential for nano-spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 该文用DFT+U研究过渡金属掺杂二维MoSe2/WSe2的稳定性与磁性，发现成对掺杂比孤立掺杂更稳定，并可在MoSe2中实现高温长程铁磁性与较大磁各向异性。
AI.motivation: 二维过渡金属硫族化合物是稀磁半导体候选平台，但同时实现大磁各向异性能（MAE）和高居里温度（T_c）仍是主要挑战。
AI.method: 采用DFT+U系统计算过渡金属原子掺杂二维MoSe2和二维WSe2的热力学稳定性与磁性质，考虑成对掺杂构型、自旋轨道耦合、交换相互作用、轨道杂化，并用Monte Carlo模拟估算T_c。
AI.result: 成对掺杂构型比孤立掺杂更稳定；二维MoSe2中成对掺杂多表现为载流子介导的长程铁磁耦合，而WSe2中交换耦合较弱；2Mn_2W由短程反铁磁耦合转为长程稳定铁磁耦合；最大面内MAE为2V_2Mo的-3.5 meV和2Mn_2W的-3.2 meV；2Fe_2Mo的T_c约为440 K。
AI.conclusion: 掺杂原子团簇是调控二维TMDs高温铁磁性的有效途径，并显示其在纳米自旋电子器件中的应用潜力。

title: Scalable MoS2/Si Photodiode Arrays from Roll-to-Roll Mechanical Exfoliation
summary: We present a scalable, all-dry route to MoS2/Si photodiodes based on high-throughput roll-to-roll mechanical exfoliation. The method yields dense films of large-lateral-size MoS2 nanosheets and enables the formation of heterojunctions that operate in the photovoltaic regime when transferred onto locally etched Si regions. Individual devices show robust, fast photoresponses and broadband wavelength sensitivity. We further implemented a linear pixel array demonstrating position sensing capability and a 4x4 array as a proof-of-concept imaging sensor. These results indicate that roll-to-roll mechanical exfoliation can overcome common limitations of solution-processed films to enable low-cost, self-powered optoelectronic detectors for sensing and imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于高通量卷对卷机械剥离的全干法制备MoS2/Si光电二极管，并演示位置传感与4×4成像阵列。
AI.motivation: 克服溶液加工薄膜的常见限制，实现低成本、自供电的光电探测与成像器件。
AI.method: 采用卷对卷机械剥离获得致密、大横向尺寸MoS2纳米片，将其转移到局部刻蚀的Si区域形成异质结，并在光伏模式下工作；进一步构建线性像素阵列和4×4阵列。
AI.result: 单个器件表现出稳健、快速的光响应和宽带波长敏感性；线性像素阵列实现位置传感，4×4阵列作为概念验证成像传感器。
AI.conclusion: 卷对卷机械剥离可克服溶液加工薄膜的限制，为低成本、自供电的光电探测、传感和成像应用提供可行路线。

title: A Geometry-Guided Feature-Space Framework for Interpretable Unsupervised 4D-STEM Analysis of Complex Multiphase Materials
summary: Rapid, high-fidelity analysis of four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) datasets from heterogeneous materials remains challenging because coexisting phases, orientation variants, local strain gradients, and intrinsic TEM thin-foil effects produce complex, overlapping diffraction signatures. Here, we present a machine-learning (ML) framework that combines physics-informed geometric descriptors with weighted high-dimensional embeddings to identify latent structural patterns with minimal prior knowledge. By constructing a regularized descriptor space before embedding and density-based clustering, the method improves cluster stability, suppresses noise-driven fragmentation, and reduces sensitivity to embedding hyperparameters. Spatial weighting produced the largest stability gain, increasing median cluster persistence from 0.04 to 0.55 while reducing the noise fraction from approximately 22% to 0%. Rotation weighting increased DBCV from 0.80 to 0.92, although the noise fraction rose from 0.2% to 1.0%, highlighting a trade-off between improved density separation and noise rejection. We validate the framework on two benchmark systems: Si/Si$_x$Ge$_{1-x}$ epitaxial layers with continuous lattice variation and deformation, and multiphase Ti-Nb alloys containing distinct phases and orientation variants. Comparisons with a pretrained vanilla autoencoder and model-free pattern vectorization show that the physics-informed geometric descriptor provides higher cluster fidelity, greater interpretability, and substantially lower dimensionality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合物理启发几何描述符与加权高维嵌入的机器学习框架，用于提升异质材料4D-STEM数据中隐藏结构模式的聚类稳定性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 4D-STEM数据中多相共存、取向变体、局部应变梯度和薄箔效应导致衍射信号复杂重叠，现有分析难以快速、高保真地识别潜在结构模式。
AI.method: 先构建正则化物理启发几何描述符空间，再进行加权高维嵌入和密度聚类；通过空间加权与旋转加权抑制噪声碎片化并降低对嵌入超参数的敏感性。
AI.result: 空间加权使中位聚类持续性从0.04提升至0.55，噪声比例从约22%降至0%；旋转加权使DBCV从0.80提升至0.92，但噪声比例从0.2%升至1.0%，体现密度分离与噪声抑制的权衡。在Si/SiGe外延层和Ti-Nb多相合金上验证，与预训练普通自编码器和无模型模式向量化相比，该方法聚类保真度更高、可解释性更强且维度显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 物理启发几何描述符结合加权嵌入与密度聚类可有效分析复杂4D-STEM数据，在异质材料相与取向变体识别中兼顾稳定性、可解释性和低维表示。

title: A data-driven approach for systematic correction of electronic bandgaps
summary: We demonstrate that a single machine-learning correction, applied to bandgaps from density functional theory calculations with two of the most frequently used energy functionals, results in bandgaps that are close to the experimental values. This solves a classical problem of computationally efficient electronic structure methods, to give reliable bandgaps that can be compared to experiments. The employed approach relies on materials specific feature engineering of machine learning models, and is shown to have close accuracy to that of much more expensive calculations based on the GW-approximation or hybrid functionals. The findings reported here open the possibility to use efficient calculations in materials design workflows that need reliable bandgaps, with implications for investigations targeting large computational databases or for investigations that are entirely predictive in nature.

AI.tldr: 该工作表明，对两种常用密度泛函的DFT带隙施加单一机器学习校正，即可获得接近实验值的带隙。
AI.motivation: 计算高效的电子结构方法难以给出可靠、可与实验比较的带隙；而GW近似或杂化泛函虽更准确但计算昂贵。
AI.method: 采用材料特定特征工程的机器学习模型，对基于两种常用能量泛函的DFT带隙进行统一校正。
AI.result: 校正后的带隙接近实验值，其精度与更昂贵的GW近似或杂化泛函计算相近。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为材料设计工作流提供高效且可靠的带隙预测手段，适用于大规模计算数据库和完全预测性研究。

title: Lifting mechanical zero modes without dispersion
summary: Floppy frameworks carry flat bands of zero-frequency mechanisms with no finite-frequency resonance, and couplings that lift them usually spread them. We show that an on-site tensor lifts a mechanism band without first-order dispersion exactly when, projected onto the mechanisms, it acts as wavevector-independent scalars on orthogonal pieces. Three structures achieve this: local normal modes, invariant symmetry sectors, and a balance law. A mechanism moves both ends of every bond between two vertex classes equally along it, and where the inter-class bond tensors are class scalars this balance law fixes its norm shares and hence the flat value from geometry alone. For the fluorite net the band lies outside the tensor spectrum, at 14/9 of the contact stiffness to first order, and stays flat to all orders in a fixed cage. A placement inside a tiling dual that keeps the common symmetry supplies such tensors, because each contact star inherits its site symmetry. Ten catalogued dual pairs lift flat; half are eigenvalue cases a resolved count matches, and the balance law explains flat bands in random cages too. Duality makes the rigid cage common. In a printable beam-frame lattice, contacts that lock joint rotation remove first-order bending dispersion whenever bonded mechanisms are orthogonal local normals.

AI.tldr: 该文给出在位张量在不引入一阶色散时抬升柔性框架零频机制平带的精确条件，并通过局域简正模、对称性扇区、平衡律和对偶构造实现与解释该现象。
AI.motivation: 柔性框架的零频机制形成无有限频率共振的平带，而常规耦合在抬升机制带时通常会使其色散化或展宽，因此需要找到既能抬升又能保持平带的条件与结构来源。
AI.method: 将在位张量投影到机制子空间，要求其在正交分量上表现为与波矢无关的标量；从局域简正模、不变对称性扇区，以及跨类键张量为类标量时的平衡律三条途径构造；利用保持共同对称性的镶嵌对偶放置张量，并在可打印梁框架中检验锁转接触。
AI.result: 得到精确判据；萤石网中该带位于张量谱外，一阶为接触刚度的14/9，且在固定笼中全阶保持平直；十个目录对偶对可抬升平带，其中一半属于可由解析计数匹配的本征值情形；平衡律也解释随机笼中的平带；梁框架中锁节点转动的接触在键合机制为正交局域简正模时消除一阶弯曲色散。
AI.conclusion: 在位张量可在特定对称与平衡条件下抬升机制带而不产生一阶色散，对偶提供刚性笼与可实现张量；锁转接触可抑制一阶弯曲色散，为设计平带柔性及可打印晶格提供判据。

title: In-Band Boundary Resonances from Coalescing Zero-Group-Velocity Points
summary: Boundary states generally reside in band gaps, whereas in-band confinement typically requires exact decoupling from propagating modes. We demonstrate an alternative mechanism in reciprocal, topologically trivial Hermitian lattices arising from the coalescence of two zero-group-velocity (ZGV) points. At coalescence, the group velocity and inverse effective mass vanish simultaneously, and the corresponding Bloch root acquires higher multiplicity. The coalesced root remains propagating, whereas nearby root splitting yields weakly evanescent channels that, together with a bulk-matched termination, generate a boundary-weighted resonance within the propagating spectrum. The mechanism is realized analytically in a two-leg ladder model through the coalescence of time-reversal-related ZGVs and extends to distinct ZGVs produced by longer-range interactions. Finite-size scaling distinguishes the resulting resonance from extended and defect-bound states. Scanning laser Doppler vibrometry on a 3D-printed elastic ladder reveals boundary enhancement in a nearly flat band region, consistent with operation slightly below criticality. ZGV coalescence thus provides a bulk framework for in-band boundary resonances in reciprocal Hermitian lattices.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并实验验证了一种在互易、拓扑平庸厄米晶格中通过两个零群速度（ZGV）点合并产生带内边界共振的机制。
AI.motivation: 传统边界态通常位于带隙中，而带内局域化往往需要与传播模式完全解耦；作者希望在不依赖拓扑或缺陷的互易厄米体系中实现传播谱内的边界增强。
AI.method: 从两个ZGV点合并出发，指出合并时群速度和有效质量倒数同时消失、Bloch根多重度提高；合并根仍为传播态，而邻近根分裂形成弱倏逝通道，配合体匹配端接产生边界加权共振。以双支梯模型解析实现时间反演相关ZGV合并，并推广至长程相互作用产生的不同ZGV；用有限尺寸标度区分共振与扩展态/缺陷束缚态，并用扫描激光多普勒振动测量测试3D打印弹性梯。
AI.result: 有限尺寸标度可识别该带内共振；3D打印弹性梯实验在近平坦带区域观察到边界增强，且与略低于临界性的工作条件一致。
AI.conclusion: ZGV合并为互易、拓扑平庸厄米晶格中的带内边界共振提供了基于体态的通用框架。

title: Deintercalation Equilibria Control the Composition, Structure, and Electronic Quality in the Synthesis of 2$M$-WS$_2$
summary: Alkali-metal intercalation-deintercalation (AMID) enables access to metastable layered materials such as 2$M$-WS$_2$. Mechanistic studies of AMID have focused on intercalation; how deintercalation proceeds and influences crystal properties is comparatively poorly understood. Here, we assess 34 deintercalation treatments of 2$M$-K$_x$WS$_2$ and find that K$^+$ removal proceeds through coupled redox and ion-exchange equilibria, whose positions set the composition, structure, and electronic quality of the products. Across a series of neat solvents, K$^+$ deintercalation amount increased with solvent polarity and was driven to near-completion upon addition of nonoxidizing crown ether chelators, regardless of solvent polarity. Spontaneous reintercalation occurred when 2$M$-WS$_2$ was placed in dilute aqueous solutions of the strong base KOH but not the neutral salt KCl. These results suggest that the extent of deintercalation is governed by the stability of K$^+$ in solution, rather than oxidant strength alone, consistent with a reaction under thermodynamic control. Treatments that bias the deintercalation equilibrium most strongly toward the products while avoiding deleterious side reactions produce the highest quality 2$M$-WS$_2$. A six-hour treatment with acidified K$_2$Cr$_2$O$_7$ gave the highest average residual resistivity ratio ($\overline{RRR}$). Residual K$^+$, quantified by ICP-MS, was found in all treated samples and appeared to impose an upper bound on $\overline{RRR}$. Treatments yielding crystals with $\overline{RRR}$ below this bound did not always afford 2$M$-WS$_2$; we observed two new structures in bleach-treated samples and signatures of alternative phases under other conditions. This work demonstrates that deintercalation is not merely a processing step in AMID but a mechanistically rich reaction that might be rationally tuned to improve and control metastable materials.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了2M-KxWS2的34种去插层处理，发现K+去除由耦合的氧化还原与离子交换平衡控制，产物组成、结构和电子质量受该平衡调控；酸性K2Cr2O7处理6小时获得最高平均剩余电阻率比，残余K+限制电子质量。
AI.motivation: 碱金属插层-去插层可实现2M-WS2等亚稳层状材料，但现有机理研究多聚焦插层，对去插层过程及其对晶体性质的影响理解不足，因此需要阐明去插层机理以实现理性调控。
AI.method: 对2M-KxWS2实施34种去插层处理，比较不同极性纯溶剂、非氧化性冠醚螯合剂、稀KOH与KCl水溶液中的再插层行为；用ICP-MS定量残余K+，以平均剩余电阻率比评价电子质量，并结合 bleach 等处理后的结构表征分析产物相。
AI.result: K+去插层量随溶剂极性增加；加入非氧化性冠醚可不受溶剂极性影响而接近完全去插层；稀KOH中发生自发再插层而KCl中不发生，表明去插层受热力学控制，取决于K+在溶液中的稳定性而非仅氧化剂强度。酸性K2Cr2O7处理6小时得到最高平均RRR；所有样品均含残余K+并似乎给出RRR上限；低于该上限的样品不总是2M-WS2，bleach处理中出现两种新结构，其他条件出现替代相信号。
AI.conclusion: 去插层并非AMID中的简单加工步骤，而是机理丰富且可通过平衡调控的反应；将去插层平衡强烈偏向产物并避免副反应可提升2M-WS2质量，残余K+是电子质量的重要限制因素，该策略可用于改进和控制亚稳材料。

authors: Dimuthu H. Thanippuli Arachchi (Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
Oliver M. Nix (Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
Moungi G. Bawendi (Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
title: Efficient Plane-to-Point Energy Transfer from Supramolecular Excitonic Systems to Molecular Acceptors
summary: Collective excitonic interactions in supramolecular assemblies offer opportunities for efficient light harvesting and directed energy transport. Here, we demonstrate efficient energy transfer from two-dimensional silica-encapsulated TDBC J-aggregate sheets to covalently attached ATTO 590 molecular acceptors. Silica encapsulation preserves the J-aggregate excitonic properties while enabling acceptor functionalization at a defined separation from the donor plane. Steady-state donor quenching and acceptor sensitization yield energy-transfer efficiencies of 75-81% in solution, while time-resolved photoluminescence measurements reveal donor lifetime shortening. We develop a generalized Forster resonance energy-transfer model for an extended planar donor coupled to localized molecular acceptors, predicting an inverse fourth-power dependence of the transfer rate on donor-acceptor separation. Using experimental spectroscopic data and estimated structural parameters, the model predicts an energy-transfer rate of 4.77 x 10^10 s^-1, approximately ten times faster than the intrinsic donor decay rate, corresponding to a theoretical energy-transfer efficiency of approximately 91%. These findings provide a framework for developing hybrid excitonic architectures for light harvesting.

AI.tldr: 该研究在二维硅包覆TDBC J-聚集体片中实现向共价连接ATTO 590受体的高效激子能量转移，并建立适用于扩展平面给体与局域受体耦合的广义FRET模型。
AI.motivation: 超分子组装中的集体激子相互作用有望用于高效光捕获与定向能量传输，因此需要构建可控的给体-受体体系并理解其能量转移规律。
AI.method: 制备二维二氧化硅包覆的TDBC J-聚集体片，并在受控距离上共价功能化ATTO 590受体；利用稳态光谱、时间分辨光致发光以及广义Forster共振能量转移模型分析给体淬灭、受体敏化和距离依赖关系。
AI.result: 溶液中能量转移效率为75-81%，时间分辨测量显示给体寿命缩短；模型预测转移速率随给体-受体间距呈四次方反比依赖，计算得到转移速率为4.77 × 10^10 s^-1，约为给体本征衰减速率的10倍，理论效率约91%。
AI.conclusion: 硅包覆J-聚集体可在保持激子性质的同时实现可控受体功能化与高效能量转移，为发展混合激子光捕获架构提供了框架。

title: Learning Electronic Band Structures Across the s, p, d Blocks with an Empirical Pseudopotential Network
summary: Electronic band structures govern how crystals conduct electrons and absorb light. Density-functional theory (DFT) computes them through costly self-consistent iterations, while existing machine-learning models either predict isolated scalar properties or output Hamiltonians that still require DFT solvers. Here we present EpNet, a learned empirical pseudopotential for crystals spanning 63 elements across the \textit{s}, \textit{p} and \textit{d} blocks. An equivariant neural network builds its Hamiltonian from physics-motivated local potentials and nonlocal projectors. Trained solely on band energies, EpNet predicts complete band structures directly from atomic coordinates. On unseen chemical systems, its median errors are \winAll\ eV for band energies and \gapAll\ eV for band gaps. On 600,000 structures from an independent database, its band-gap errors are overall less than half those of existing models, at about 1\% of DFT cost. EpNet thus enables fast screening of electronic properties for materials discovery and electronic-structure simulations of large systems.

AI.tldr: EpNet 是一种覆盖 63 种元素的 learned empirical pseudopotential，利用等变神经网络从原子坐标直接预测完整电子能带结构，以约 1% 的 DFT 成本实现高精度带隙与带能预测。
AI.motivation: DFT 计算能带需昂贵自洽迭代；现有机器学习方法多只预测孤立标量性质，或输出仍需 DFT 求解的哈密顿量，难以直接、低成本获得完整能带结构。
AI.method: 构建跨 s、p、d 区 63 种元素的晶体经验赝势 EpNet；用等变神经网络基于物理启发的局域势和非局域投影子构造哈密顿量；仅以带能量训练，直接从原子坐标预测完整能带结构。
AI.result: 在未见化学体系上，带能中位误差为摘要中占位符 \winAll eV、带隙为 \gapAll eV；在独立数据库 600,000 个结构上，带隙误差总体低于现有模型的一半，计算成本约为 DFT 的 1%。
AI.conclusion: EpNet 可用于材料发现中的电子性质快速筛选，并支持大体系电子结构模拟。

title: Effect of Correlation on the Pressure-Induced Insulator to Metal Transition in Complex Spin-Orbit Coupled Double Perovskite La$_2$CoIr$_{1-x}$Ti$_x$O$_6$
summary: We study the effect of electron correlation ($U$) and hydrostatic pressure on the electronic properties of double perovskites La$_2$CoIr$_{1-x}$Ti$_x$O$_6$ for $x$ = 0, 0.5, and 1, using first-principles electronic structure calculations within density functional theory (DFT). At ambient pressure, we systematically vary the electron correlation, i.e., on-site Coulomb interaction to study its effect on band gap and structural parameters. Increasing the value of $U$ enhances the band gap of all three compositions while producing only a slight variation in structural parameters. The effect of hydrostatic pressure is also studied for the same compositions. The estimated band gap values at ambient pressure closes at approximately 39, 42, and 53 GPa for $x$ = 0 (for $U_\mathrm{Co}$ = 5 eV and $U_\mathrm{Ir}$ = 2 eV), 0.5 (for $U_\mathrm{Co}$ = 5 eV and $U_\mathrm{Ir}$ = 2 eV), and 1 (for $U_\mathrm{Co}$ = 4 eV), respectively, indicating pressure-induced insulator-to-metal transitions. These results show that electron correlation stabilises the insulating state, whereas hydrostatic pressure favours the metallic state by closing the band gap. These findings highlight the tunability of correlated oxides through electron correlations and pressure, offering insights for materials design.

AI.tldr: 采用DFT研究La$_2$CoIr$_{1-x}$Ti$_x$O$_6$（x=0、0.5、1）中电子关联U和静水压对电子性质的影响，发现U增大带隙，压力使带隙闭合并诱导绝缘体-金属转变。
AI.motivation: 阐明电子关联与静水压如何调控双钙钛矿的电子结构及绝缘体-金属转变，为关联氧化物材料设计提供依据。
AI.method: 使用第一性原理密度泛函理论计算，系统改变在位库仑相互作用U，并施加静水压，分析三种组分的带隙和结构参数。
AI.result: 增大U会增大所有组分带隙，结构参数仅轻微变化；环境压力下带隙在约39 GPa（x=0，U_Co=5 eV、U_Ir=2 eV）、42 GPa（x=0.5，同上）和53 GPa（x=1，U_Co=4 eV）闭合，表明压力诱导绝缘体-金属转变。
AI.conclusion: 电子关联稳定绝缘态，静水压通过闭合带隙促进金属态；关联氧化物的电子性质可通过U和压力调控，具有材料设计意义。

title: Strain Controlled Hydrogen Interstitial Site Preference and Hydride Phase Suppression in Epitaxial Vanadium
summary: Understanding hydrogen behavior in transition metals is crucial for energy storage and sensing technologies. Here we combine density functional theory (DFT) calculations with in-situ electrical measurements to reveal how epitaxial strain governs hydrogen interstitial site selection and phase stability in vanadium. Our calculations demonstrate a robust thermodynamic preference for tetrahedral (T) over octahedral (O) sites, with the energy difference modulated by lattice anisotropy through strain-tunable H 1s-V 3d orbital hybridization. Experimentally, epitaxial V films on MgO(001) exhibit a critical thickness-dependent crossover: 50 nm films show characteristic first-order alpha-beta hydride transitions, while 10 nm films display continuous solid-solution behavior with complete transition suppression. This crossover is governed by the progressive relaxation of epitaxial strain with increasing film thickness: the 10 nm films retain strong coherent strain that flattens the free-energy landscape and suppresses hydride nucleation, whereas the 50 nm films approach the strain-relaxed bulk limit where long-range elastic interactions restore first-order phase behavior. Finite-size truncation of elastic fields and interfacial electronic reconstruction further reinforce this dimensional crossover. Our work establishes a unified framework connecting atomic-scale orbital physics to mesoscopic phase thermodynamics, providing design principles for strain-engineered metal-hydride systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合DFT与原位电学测量，揭示外延应变通过调控H 1s-V 3d轨道杂化决定钒中氢间隙位选择与氢化物相稳定性，并发现薄膜厚度驱动的相变行为转变。
AI.motivation: 理解过渡金属中氢行为对储能与传感技术至关重要，但外延应变如何影响氢间隙占位和金属-氢化物相变尚需统一框架。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论计算结合原位电学测量，研究外延钒薄膜中的氢占位与相变；比较四面体T位与八面体O位能量，并测试MgO(001)上不同厚度外延V薄膜。
AI.result: 计算表明T位相对O位具有稳健热力学偏好，能差受晶格各向异性及应变可调H 1s-V 3d杂化调制；实验发现50 nm薄膜呈现一级α-β氢化物转变，而10 nm薄膜表现为连续固溶行为且转变被完全抑制。
AI.conclusion: 厚度依赖的交叉源于外延应变随厚度弛豫：10 nm强共格应变展平自由能并抑制氢化物形核，50 nm接近弛豫 bulk 极限并由长程弹性相互作用恢复一级相变；弹性场有限尺寸截断与界面电子重构进一步强化该维度交叉，为应变工程金属-氢化物系统提供设计原则。

title: sdos: spectral densities of large sparse Hermitian and generalized eigenproblems
summary: sdos is an open Python package that computes the density of states (DOS) and related spectral quantities of very large sparse Hermitian matrices A, and of generalized problems A psi = lambda B psi, from Chebyshev moments estimated with random vectors. The density is reconstructed by the kernel polynomial method (KPM, the default) or by maximum entropy (Maxent); the same interface gives band energies, Fermi levels, local and projected densities, harmonic thermodynamics, exact HOMO-LUMO gaps and eigenpairs in a spectral window. Interfaces cover electronic (empirical tight-binding, DFTB, SIESTA) and vibrational (matrix-free LAMMPS Hessians) problems. I checked most ingredients against dense diagonalization or an independent code; the exceptions are listed in Sec. V. On a workstation (4 threads, 19 GB) the DOS of an 884,736-atom amorphous silicon model (a 6^3 tiling of a 4096-atom cell; 3.5 million orbitals; the orthogonal empirical tight-binding model of Kwon et al.) takes 71 s (M=100, R=2, no exact moments; 383 s with the default exact moments), and a matrix-free 2,097,152-atom crystal 10 min in 1.8 GB. A 17^3 replica of a 216-atom amorphous cell (1,061,208 atoms) agrees with exact Bloch spectra: electronic DOS in 229 s, matrix-free ACE vibrational DOS in 2.2 h on one GPU. Shift-invert, incomplete-Cholesky setup, exact moments of high order and Maxent at high moment counts do not scale. The underlying methods are due to Silver, Roder, Kress, Voter, Drabold, Sankey and collaborators; the Introduction states what is added.

AI.tldr: sdos 是一个开源 Python 包，利用随机向量估计的 Chebyshev 矩，为超大规模稀疏 Hermitian 矩阵及广义本征问题 Aψ=λBψ 计算态密度（DOS）和相关谱量，默认用 KPM 重构，也支持最大熵（Maxent）。
AI.motivation: 面向电子与振动问题中超大规模稀疏矩阵的 DOS 及谱量计算需求，提供统一、可扩展且可验证的工具，覆盖经验紧束缚、DFTB、SIESTA 和基于 LAMMPS Hessian 的无矩阵振动问题。
AI.method: 用随机向量估计 Chebyshev 矩，通过核多项式方法（KPM，默认）或最大熵重构 DOS；同一接口可给能带能量、费米能级、局域/投影态密度、谐热力学量、精确 HOMO-LUMO 带隙及谱窗内本征对；支持矩阵自由计算。
AI.result: 多数组件已与稠密对角化或独立代码校验，例外见 Sec. V。工作站（4 线程、19 GB）上，884,736 原子非晶硅模型（350 万轨道）DOS 在 M=100、R=2、无精确矩时耗时 71 s，默认精确矩为 383 s；无矩阵 2,097,152 原子晶体 10 min、1.8 GB。216 原子非晶胞的 17^3 复制（1,061,208 原子）与精确 Bloch 谱一致，电子 DOS 229 s，单 GPU 上 ACE 振动 DOS 2.2 h。Shift-invert、不完全 Cholesky 预处理、高阶精确矩及高矩数 Maxent 不可扩展。
AI.conclusion: sdos 为超大稀疏 Hermitian/广义本征问题提供了可扩展的开源 DOS 与谱量计算框架，并在大规模电子和振动体系上展示了效率与一致性，但部分高成本组件存在明显扩展性限制。

title: Crystal and magnetic structures of MnSi in zero magnetic field: Neutron diffraction and symmetry analysis
summary: Combining high-resolution wide-angle neutron powder diffraction with magnetic-superspace symmetry analysis, we refine the crystal structure and present, to our knowledge, the first systematic refinement of cubic $P2_13$ MnSi's zero-field magnetic structure across multiple magnetic satellite families. We compare single-arm rhombohedral 3+1D and cubic four-arm 3+4D magnetic superspace-group (MSSG) descriptions with propagation vectors along $\langle111\rangle$. Simultaneous extinction of the two satellite groups around $\{100\}$ dictates a transverse circular-helix model. This suppression and refinements of 18 separately varied satellite-group intensities support this ideal limit with only one adjustable magnetic amplitude. In the ideal single-arm model with MSSG $R3.1'(0,0,g)ts$, the moment has constant magnitude 0.535(3) $\mu_B$ per Mn. An explicit four-arm 3+4D cubic superspace construction presented here combines four interpenetrating helices and, for the illustrated phase choice, has moments ranging from zero to 0.874(5) $\mu_B$ per Mn, with the same root-mean-square moment as the 3+1D structure. Their identical powder profiles prevent the present measurements from distinguishing them. The average crystal structure remains cubic within experimental resolution, providing structural motivation for the cubic magnetic model. The mean lattice parameter, determined with formal relative precision $\sigma_a/a \lesssim 10^{-5}$, exhibits nonmonotonic temperature dependence below the N\'eel temperature.

AI.tldr: 结合高分辨宽角中子粉末衍射与磁性超空间对称性分析，系统精修了立方P2_13 MnSi零场磁结构，并用单臂3+1D与四臂3+4D磁性超空间群模型比较其沿⟨111⟩传播的螺旋磁结构。
AI.motivation: 在多个磁卫星族上系统精修MnSi零场磁结构，判别单臂菱方3+1D与立方四臂3+4D磁性超空间群描述，并检验横向圆螺旋模型。
AI.method: 采用高分辨宽角中子粉末衍射和磁性超空间对称性分析，同时拟合18组独立变化的卫星群强度；比较传播矢量沿⟨111⟩的单臂R3.1'(0,0,g)ts与四臂3+4D立方超空间构造，并利用{100}附近两组卫星的同时消光约束模型。
AI.result: {100}附近两组卫星的同时消光支持横向圆螺旋的理想极限，仅需一个可调磁振幅。单臂模型中Mn磁矩恒为0.535(3) μB；显式四臂3+4D立方构造给出0至0.874(5) μB的Mn磁矩，但与3+1D具有相同均方根磁矩，且二者粉末衍射谱相同，当前数据无法区分。平均晶体结构在实验分辨率内仍为立方；平均晶格参数精度σa/a≲10^-5，并在奈尔温度以下呈非单调温度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 粉末衍射数据支持具有单一磁振幅的理想横向圆螺旋模型，立方平均结构为立方磁模型提供结构依据；但单臂与四臂磁性超空间描述给出相同粉末谱，需进一步测量区分，且晶格参数在奈尔温度以下存在非单调行为。

title: Orbital texture of valence band and interband transitions of the type-II multiferroic van der Waals NiI$_2$
summary: NiI$_2$ is a van der Waals semiconductor characterized by complex electronic and magnetic phases, holding promise towards functional applications. For this purpose, a detailed understanding of its band structure and its excitations is essential to elucidate the electronic and transport properties. We present a comprehensive description of the band structure and of the lowest valence-to-conduction band transition in bulk NiI$_2$, by means of time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy supported by first-principles calculations. We describe the orbital character of Ni and I manifolds, and identify the main momentum-resolved features of the valence band and the shallow minima of the conduction band. With this study, we provide a foundational understanding of the electronic structure of NiI$_2$ and its single-particle interband electronic excitation, a benchmark for theoretical models, and a framework for future investigations on this material.

AI.tldr: 该文利用时间与角分辨光电子能谱结合第一性原理计算，系统表征了块体NiI2的能带结构及最低价带到导带的单粒子跃迁。
AI.motivation: NiI2是一种具有复杂电子与磁性物相、应用前景广阔的范德华半导体；要理解其电子与输运性质并推动功能应用，需要详细掌握其能带结构和激发行为。
AI.method: 采用时间与角分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES），并辅以第一性原理计算，对块体NiI2的能带结构及最低价带到导带跃迁进行研究。
AI.result: 阐明了Ni和I多带的轨道特征，识别了价带的主要动量分辨特征以及导带的浅极小值，并描述了最低价带到导带的单粒子带间电子激发。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为NiI2的电子结构及单粒子带间激发提供了基础性认识，可作为理论模型的基准，并为后续研究建立框架。

title: Overcoming speed-accuracy trade-offs with medium-sized interatomic potentials
summary: Current machine-learned interatomic potentials offer a choice between small, fast models and large, expressive networks. This study demonstrates how an intermediate potential can approach the limit of transferable accuracy at the cost of the cheapest existing formalisms. Specifically, we model He-bearing W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti alloys with an atomic cluster expansion that learns the radial components of each polynomial as independent linear transforms and embeds numerous densities with learned exponents. While (near-)training loss appears largely a function of model size, the error on a distinct validation set is close to that of leading potentials with ten times more parameters. Taking advantage of the new structure, we develop optimized implementations that run more than an order of magnitude faster than the larger models and many times faster than smaller models with equivalent polynomials. The potential is trained on systematically enumerated small structures but generalizes to point and planar defects and can be extended to even more complex chemistries. As a demonstration, we simulate radiation-damage cascades in billion-atom systems for hundreds of thousands of timesteps.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种中等规模的原子团簇展开势，在可迁移精度上接近更大模型，同时通过优化实现显著提升速度，并用于十亿原子级辐射损伤级联模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习原子间势通常在小而快与大而强表达力之间取舍，作者希望以较低计算成本逼近可迁移精度的极限。
AI.method: 针对含 He 的 W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti 合金，构建原子团簇展开势：将每个多项式的径向分量学习为独立线性变换，并用学习到的指数嵌入多种密度；同时开发优化实现以加速计算。
AI.result: 训练/近训练损失主要随模型规模变化，但在独立验证集上的误差接近参数量多十倍的领先势；优化实现比更大模型快一个数量级以上，也比具有等效多项式的更小模型快许多；该势在系统枚举的小结构上训练后可泛化到点缺陷和面缺陷，并支持十亿原子体系数十万时间步的辐射损伤级联模拟。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明中等规模、结构改进且高度优化的机器学习势可在精度与效率之间取得更优平衡，并具备扩展到更复杂化学组成和大规模缺陷/辐照模拟的潜力。

title: Hydrogen Thermodiffusion in Tungsten: Trapped Hydrogen Distorts Heat of Transport Estimation from Total Concentration Profiles
summary:
We investigate hydrogen diffusion in tungsten under thermal gradients in the presence of trapping sites using multiscale simulations. Using molecular dynamics simulations, we find that the heat of transport, which quantifies the coupling between temperature gradients and hydrogen transport, for hydrogen in tungsten is positive (thermophobic) at lower temperatures but changes sign near $1000$ K. We investigate the origin of the heat of transport and find that harmonic transition state theory with elastic thermal-expansion corrections is insufficient to explain the observed behaviour, consistent with either a breakdown of local thermodynamic equilibrium or non-negligible anharmonic contributions.
  We further extend previous studies of hydrogen thermodiffusion by including the effect of trapping sites in both simulations and analytical models. We show that when trapped hydrogen accounts for a significant fraction of the total hydrogen concentration, the heat of transport inferred from measurements of the total concentration is dominated by the temperature dependence of the trapped hydrogen population and no longer reflects the gradient in the mobile hydrogen concentration. Consequently, experimentally measured heats of transport cannot in general be used directly in continuum-scale models that explicitly account for trapping and detrapping. In such models, the heat of transport should be based on mobile hydrogen concentrations only to avoid incorporating trapping effects twice.

AI.tldr: 该文用多尺度模拟研究钨中氢在温度梯度下的热扩散及陷阱效应，发现热输运热Q*随温度变号，并指出含陷阱时由总氢浓度推断的Q*不能直接用于显式包含俘获/脱附的连续介质模型。
AI.motivation: 氢在钨中的热扩散对聚变材料中氢滞留和输运至关重要，但温度梯度与陷阱共同作用下的热输运热来源及实验可测Q*的解释仍不清楚。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学模拟计算钨中氢的热输运热，并结合谐振过渡态理论与弹性热膨胀修正分析其来源；进一步在模拟和解析模型中引入陷阱位点，研究俘获氢对热扩散和Q*推断的影响。
AI.result: 氢在钨中的Q*在较低温度为正值（ thermophobic ），在约1000 K附近变号；谐振过渡态理论加弹性热膨胀修正不足以解释该行为，暗示局域热力学平衡失效或非谐贡献不可忽略。当俘获氢占总氢浓度显著比例时，由总浓度测量的Q*主要由俘获氢布居的温度依赖性支配，不再反映可动氢浓度梯度。
AI.conclusion: 实验测得的Q*通常不能直接用于显式处理俘获与脱附的连续介质模型；此类模型应仅基于可动氢浓度定义Q*，以避免重复计入陷阱效应。

title: Strain-dependent Dynamics of Interactions of Iodine-vacancy pairs in CsPbI3: A DFT and Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Study
summary: Iodine-vacancy migration and association are important factors in the structural stability of halide perovskites. Although neighboring vacancies have been suggested to form energetically favorable pairs, their stability and reconfiguration under finite-temperature lattice deformation remain unclear. Here, we combine machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) and density functional theory (DFT) to investigate neighboring iodine vacancies in tilted CsPbI3 under isotropic and biaxial strain. The MLMD trajectories reveal a nonmonotonic dependence of short-time hopping fractions on strain, with strong isotropic compression favoring point-like separation and tension promoting pair-preserving relay hopping. Notably, biaxial compression produces distinct orientation-dependent responses: vacancy pairs initially aligned with the compressed plane preferentially undergo separation, whereas those perpendicular to the plane predominantly exhibit relay hopping. Complementary static calculations using DFT and the SevenNet-0 potential yield repulsive interactions for all configurations examined. These findings highlight the importance of finite-temperature dynamics and strain-dependent local geometry in understanding vacancy-pair stability and reconfiguration in halide perovskites.

AI.tldr: 该文结合机器学习分子动力学与DFT，研究倾斜CsPbI3中相邻碘空位在等轴与双轴应变下的迁移、配对稳定性和重构行为。
AI.motivation: 相邻碘空位被认为可形成能量有利的空位对，但其在有限温度晶格形变下的稳定性与重构机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用机器学习分子动力学（MLMD）模拟倾斜CsPbI3中相邻碘空位在等轴和双轴应变下的短时跳跃行为，并用DFT及SevenNet-0势进行静态能量计算。
AI.result: MLMD轨迹显示短时跳跃分数随应变非单调变化：强等轴压缩倾向点状分离，拉伸促进保持空位对的接力跳跃；双轴压缩呈取向依赖响应，平行于压缩面的空位对优先分离，垂直者主要接力跳跃。DFT与SevenNet-0静态计算则对所有考察构型给出排斥相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 有限温度动力学和应变依赖的局域几何对卤化物钙钛矿中空位对的稳定性与重构至关重要，静态计算不足以完整描述其行为。

title: Misorientations in dislocation cell structures: Modelling and statistical analysis
summary: Dislocation pattern formation is accompanied by the emergence of lattice rotations and concomitant misorientations across dislocation walls (cell boundaries). Recent advances in mesoscopic modelling of dislocation patterns enable for the first time a systematic simulation study of this phenomenon. We present simulation results for lattice rotation and misorientation patterns in crystals with face-centered cubic and rocksalt lattice structure. Statistical analysis of the orientation changes across cell walls reveals a transition associated with a symmetry-breaking bifurcation in slip system activity: Below the bifurcation, statistical tests indicate the presence of a single population of misoriented walls whereas, above the bifurcation, two sub-populations of 'incidental' and 'geometrically necessary' dislocation walls are present. Our data analytic approach demonstrates that this distinction does not require prior image segmentation and emphasizes the statistical robustness of the distinction between two types of dislocation walls.

AI.tldr: 该文利用介观位错动力学模拟与统计数据分析，研究面心立方和岩盐结构晶体中位错图案形成时的晶格旋转及位错墙取向差，发现滑移系活动的对称破缺分岔可区分两类位错墙。
AI.motivation: 位错图案形成伴随晶格旋转和跨越位错墙（胞壁）的取向差，但缺乏对位错墙取向差群体及其转变的系统统计研究。
AI.method: 采用介观尺度位错图案模拟，获得面心立方与岩盐晶体的晶格旋转和取向差模式；对跨胞壁取向变化进行统计分析，且无需预先图像分割。
AI.result: 统计分析揭示与滑移系活动对称破缺分岔相关的转变：分岔以下仅存在单一取向差墙群体；分岔以上出现“偶然型”和“几何必需型”两个位错墙亚群体。
AI.conclusion: 两类位错墙的区分具有统计稳健性，且该数据驱动分析方法不依赖先验图像分割，为位错图案与取向差研究提供可靠途径。

title: Designed atomic displacements for finite-temperature phonons from few force calculations
summary: Finite-temperature phonons are usually fitted to first-principles forces in randomly displaced supercells, and each force calculation can be expensive. We introduce special optimal thermal cells (SOTCs), in which the displacements are designed rather than drawn at random. Our design, SOTC-D, starts from a harmonic trial model. It gives every supercell phonon mode its quantum-thermal amplitude, chooses the sign of each mode so that the force constants are best determined, and pairs each configuration with its inverse so that cubic forces cancel. Updating the trial leads to the self-consistent harmonic solution. Cells that match displacement correlations instead give good thermodynamics but not better dispersions. For eleven crystals, eight force calculations reproduce the effective dispersions within 0.03-0.31 THz, and SOTC-D is the most accurate of five designs in 9 of them. After one trial update, it beats random sampling in all crystals at 4-16 calculations and two-iteration stochastic sampling (sTDEP) in all at eight (supercell basis). On model potentials, the self-consistent form needs 2-16 times fewer calculations than the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation in 13 of 14 cases. With the HSE06 hybrid functional, it is ahead of pooled sTDEP at 4-16 calculations in Si and NaCl, and it gives the thermal expansion of Al within 3% of experiment at 300K. The method has limits: in Al and Si cells of more than 100 atoms, sTDEP is more accurate beyond 4-16 calculations (not so in NaCl up to 16); for dynamically stabilized bcc Zr, the outcome depends on the seed; and above 400 K, the free-energy curvature is not resolved.

AI.tldr: SOTC-D 通过从谐波试探模型设计有限温度声子超胞位移，显著减少第一性原理力计算量，并在多种晶体中提高色散与热力学精度。
AI.motivation: 有限温度声子通常需在随机位移超胞中拟合第一性原理力，每个力计算昂贵，因此需要更高效且准确的位移采样方案。
AI.method: 提出 special optimal thermal cells（SOTCs），其中 SOTC-D 从谐波试探模型出发，为每个超胞声子模式赋予量子热振幅，选择模式符号以最佳确定力常数，并将每个构型与其反构型配对以抵消三次力；更新试探模型可得到自洽谐波解。匹配位移相关性的超胞可给出良好热力学但不会改善色散。
AI.result: 对 11 种晶体，仅 8 次力计算即可在 0.03–0.31 THz 内重现有效色散，SOTC-D 在 9 种中为五种设计中最准确；一次试探更新后，在 4–16 次计算时优于随机采样，在 8 次（超胞基）时优于两迭代随机采样 sTDEP。模型势上，自洽形式在 14 例中的 13 例比随机自洽谐波近似少 2–16 倍计算。使用 HSE06 杂化泛函时，Si 和 NaCl 在 4–16 次计算下优于 pooled sTDEP，Al 的 300 K 热膨胀与实验相差 3% 以内。
AI.conclusion: SOTC-D 是一种高效且通常更准确的有限温度声子方法，但存在限制：在超过 100 原子的 Al 和 Si 超胞中，sTDEP 在 4–16 次计算后更准确（NaCl 至 16 次并非如此）；动态稳定的 bcc Zr 结果依赖种子；400 K 以上自由能曲率无法分辨。

title: Multichannel Phonon Interconversion Drives 90 Polarization Rotation for Stable Domain Walls in Hafnium Oxide
summary: Polarization rotation is a fundamental mechanism in ferroelectric materials, yet how such rotation arises microscopically in fluorite ferroelectrics and gives rise to distinct domain walls (DW) remains unresolved. Phonon modes offer a microscopic route to such structural transformations, as geometric orientations can modify their frequencies, dispersion relations, and vibrational eigenstates when their characteristic wavelengths become comparable to relevant physical dimensions. Here, by combining condensed phonon mode decomposition with first-principles calculations, we investigate the origin of 90 polarization rotation in the ferroelectric phase of HfO2. Using the cubic parent phase as reference, we show that polarization rotation originates from multiple symmetry equivalent phonon modes of distinct eigenstates at different wavevectors in the Brillouin zone, whose coupling and cooperative reorientation continuously evolve to generate distinct 90 Pca21 variants and switching pathways. Among the 90 variants, the lowest-energy switching pathway through the Pmn21 exhibits an energy barrier comparable to, but slightly lower than, that of the 180 polarization reversal pathway through the P42/nmc phase, indicating that 90 polarization rotation is an energetically accessible alternative switching route. We further analyze 90 DW and find that frustrated phonon modes emerge at the wall center, where the coexistence and competition of condensed modes promote local reconfiguration of the lattice distortions, contributing to the elevated DW energies. Importantly, experimental observations with STEM imaging provide direct evidence of atomic mode distortions in stable 90 DW, consistent with the theoretically identified low-energy DW. These findings provide the fundamental structural mechanism underlying 90 switching dynamics, competing domain-wall physics, and macroscopic ferroelectric behavior.

AI.tldr: 该文结合凝聚声子模式分解与第一性原理计算，揭示HfO2铁电相中90°极化旋转源于布里渊区不同波矢处多个对称等价声子模的耦合与协同重取向，并据此解释90°畴壁能量及可访问的切换路径。
AI.motivation: 氟石铁电体中90°极化旋转的微观起源及其对应畴壁（DW）的形成机制尚不明确；声子模式可为理解此类结构转变、模式耦合和畴壁局域畸变提供微观途径。
AI.method: 以立方母相为参考，采用凝聚声子模式分解结合第一性原理计算，分析HfO2中铁电90°极化旋转、不同90° Pca21变体及切换路径，并研究90°畴壁中的声子模式行为；同时结合STEM实验成像验证畴壁原子尺度模式畸变。
AI.result: 研究表明，90°极化旋转由不同波矢、不同本征态的多个对称等价声子模耦合和协同重取向连续演化产生，形成不同90° Pca21变体及切换路径。最低能的90°切换路径经Pmn21相，其能垒与经P42/nmc相的180°极化反转路径相当但略低，说明90°旋转是能量上可访问的替代切换路径。90°畴壁中心出现受挫声子模，凝聚模式的共存与竞争促使局域晶格畸变重构，导致畴壁能升高；STEM观测到稳定90°畴壁中的原子模式畸变，与理论识别的低能畴壁一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作阐明了HfO2中90°极化旋转与切换动力学的微观结构机制，揭示了竞争性畴壁物理的来源，并将微观声子模式、畴壁能量与宏观铁电行为联系起来。

title: Defects and Structural Evolution in CrSBr: Machine-Learning Potentials for Atomistic Simulations
summary: The layered van der Waals semiconductor CrSBr combines intrinsic magnetic order with semiconducting and optical properties, making it a promising material for multifunctional electronic and photonic applications. Understanding how defects and structural transformations affect its properties under experimentally relevant conditions, however, remains challenging for first-principles simulations due to the relevant length and time scales. Here, we develop and benchmark machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for the Cr-S-Br system, enabling large-scale atomistic simulations of CrSBr with accuracy approaching that of density functional theory (DFT). The charge-aware variant qNEP achieves near-DFT accuracy in predicting lattice constants, formation enthalpies, vacancy energetics, and the anisotropic pressure response of o-CrSBr. Nudged elastic band calculations reveal that pre-existing S vacancies lower the Cr Frenkel-pair migration barrier by up to 1.1 eV, providing an atomistic mechanism for beam-induced Cr redistribution and structural transformations. Displacement threshold calculations further show that Br is the most susceptible species to electron-beam-induced displacement, identifying the relative ease of removing different atomic species. Together, these results establish a validated computational framework for investigating atomic-scale disorder and structural transformations in CrSBr, providing a basis for defect engineering in materials for future magneto-optoelectronic applications.

AI.tldr: 该文为Cr-S-Br体系开发并基准测试了机器学习原子间势（MLIP），其中电荷感知的qNEP版本可接近DFT精度，并用于大尺度模拟CrSBr的缺陷、迁移和辐照位移行为。
AI.motivation: CrSBr兼具本征磁序、半导体性和光学性质，是多功能电子/光子器件的候选材料；但缺陷和结构转变在实验相关条件下的模拟受限于DFT的长度和时间尺度。
AI.method: 构建并评测Cr-S-Br体系MLIP，重点发展电荷感知qNEP；用其预测晶格常数、形成焓、空位 energetics 和o-CrSBr各向异性压力响应，并进行NEB迁移势垒与电子束位移阈值计算。
AI.result: qNEP在晶格常数、形成焓、空位能量学及o-CrSBr各向异性压力响应上接近DFT精度；NEB显示预存S空位可将Cr Frenkel对迁移势垒降低最多1.1 eV；位移阈值计算表明Br最易被电子束诱导位移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了经DFT验证的CrSBr大尺度原子模拟框架，揭示了S空位促进Cr再分布及Br易位移的原子机制，为未来磁光电子材料中的缺陷工程提供基础。

title: Ultrafast Liquid Jet X-ray Total Scattering
summary: X-ray free-electron lasers (XFELs) provide the temporal resolution needed to extend total scattering and pair distribution function (PDF) analysis to investigate structural dynamics on femtosecond-to-picosecond timescales. We recently demonstrated that high-quality total scattering data and PDFs can be obtained from individual XFEL pulses; here, we take the next step towards time-resolved studies of structural dynamics in solution. Using the Materials Imaging and Dynamics (MID) instrument at the European XFEL, we obtain total scattering data up to $Q_{\max} = 16.4\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}^{-1}$ from both conventional capillary samples and, critically, from samples delivered by a liquid jet. Despite the large air and solvent backgrounds inherent to this setup, PDFs suitable for quantitative structural analysis are recovered from liquid dispersions and molecular clusters in solution. We further demonstrate pump-probe total scattering from $\mathrm{CsPbBr}_3$ nanocrystals in a liquid jet, resolving a fluence-dependent photoinduced isotropic lattice strain. Additionally, empirical potential structure refinement (EPSR) of XFEL total scattering data from an aqueous Keggin cluster reveals site-specific hydration environments and enables three-dimensional mapping of the surrounding solvent structure. Together, these advances open the door to tracking not only ultrafast structural changes in solution, but also the evolving solvent environments that govern molecular behaviour and reactivity.

AI.tldr: 利用欧洲XFEL的MID装置，从液体射流样品获取高质量总散射/PDF数据，并实现泵浦-探测溶液结构动力学与溶剂环境三维解析。
AI.motivation: 将总散射和PDF分析扩展到飞秒至皮秒时间尺度，以研究溶液中的结构动力学及其溶剂环境。
AI.method: 在欧洲XFEL的MID仪器上，从毛细管和液体射流样品采集Qmax=16.4 Å⁻¹的总散射数据；对CsPbBr₃纳米晶液体射流进行泵浦-探测总散射，并对水相Keggin簇数据开展EPSR建模。
AI.result: 尽管空气和溶剂背景较强，仍获得可用于定量结构分析的PDF；泵浦-探测显示CsPbBr₃纳米晶具有注量依赖的光致各向同性晶格应变；EPSR揭示了Keggin簇的位点特异性水合环境并实现周围溶剂结构的三维映射。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为追踪溶液中超快结构变化及调控分子行为和反应性的动态溶剂环境开辟了道路。

title: Atomically Sharp Magnetic Domain Walls beyond Micromagnetics
summary: Atomically narrow magnetic domain walls can arise in ultrathin magnetic films, van der Waals magnets, and systems with reduced effective exchange stiffness due to competing exchange interactions. As their width approaches the atomic lattice spacing, the continuum approximation underlying micromagnetics becomes increasingly unreliable. We investigate the structure and stability of such domain walls in a one-dimensional nearest-neighbor J-K-D spin-lattice model incorporating Heisenberg exchange, uniaxial anisotropy, and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI). In the absence of DMI, we demonstrate analytically a continuous transition to an atomically sharp easy-axis wall at the critical exchange-to-anisotropy ratio J/K = 3/2, characterized by the softening of a localized Hessian mode. Atomistic spin-dynamics simulations confirm this transition and reveal that fitting discrete wall profiles with the conventional micromagnetic solution, as commonly done in experimental analyses, underestimates the exchange interaction and overestimates the anisotropy. Finite DMI removes the perfectly collinear wall as a stationary configuration, replacing the transition by a smooth crossover toward a strongly localized but canted wall that approaches the collinear easy-axis configuration only asymptotically in the strong-anisotropy limit. We derive an analytical expression for the DMI-induced canting in this regime and demonstrate its strongly enhanced canting response near the critical ratio. These findings establish the limitations of micromagnetic descriptions of atomically narrow domain walls and suggest opportunities for controlling their structure through anisotropy and DMI.

AI.tldr: 该文研究一维最近邻 J-K-D 自旋晶格模型中原子级窄磁畴壁的结构与稳定性，揭示连续微磁学在畴壁宽度接近晶格常数时的失效，并给出临界交换-各向异性比、DMI 诱导倾转及拟合偏差。
AI.motivation: 超薄磁性薄膜、范德华磁体及交换刚度降低体系中可出现原子级窄畴壁；当畴壁宽度接近晶格间距时，基于连续近似的微磁学描述可能不可靠，需要从离散自旋晶格角度理解其结构与稳定性。
AI.method: 构建包含海森堡交换、单轴各向异性和 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用（DMI）的一维最近邻 J-K-D 自旋晶格模型；在无 DMI 时进行解析分析并用原子尺度自旋动力学模拟验证；进一步分析有限 DMI 下畴壁构型、倾转及临界行为，并推导 DMI 诱导倾转的解析表达式。
AI.result: 无 DMI 时，在临界交换-各向异性比 J/K=3/2 处发生向原子级锐利易轴畴壁的连续转变，伴随局域 Hessian 模式软化；原子尺度模拟证实该转变，并表明用常规微磁学解拟合离散畴壁轮廓会低估交换作用、高估各向异性。有限 DMI 使完全共线畴壁不再作为稳态构型，将转变替换为向强局域但倾转畴壁的平滑交叉，且在强各向异性极限下才渐近趋于共线易轴构型；DMI 诱导的倾转在临界比附近响应显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了微磁学描述原子级窄畴壁的局限性，并表明可通过各向异性和 DMI 调控此类畴壁的结构与倾转响应。

title: Ultrafast Inter-Aggregate Energy Transfer Drives Efficient Charge Generation in Organic Homojunctions
summary: Y6-based homojunction organic photovoltaic devices have recently achieved exceptional power conversion efficiencies, surpassing those of conventional organic photovoltaic materials. Although unusually long exciton diffusion lengths and efficient exciton dissociation have been reported, the fundamental mechanism underlying this outstanding performance remains under debate. Here, we report that structurally distinct aggregates in Y6 thin films exhibit complementary charge-transfer (CT) characters that enable directional energy transfer and enhanced exciton delocalization. Using ultrafast spectroscopy, we identify highly efficient F\"orster resonance energy transfer (FRET) between Y6 aggregates, with an ensemble-averaged efficiency of 65% occurring on a sub-picosecond timescale (<1 ps). This aggregate-mediated energy-transfer pathway drives long-range energy migration in Y6 thin films and accounts for the remarkable external quantum efficiencies observed in homojunction devices, even in the absence of conventional donor-acceptor bulk heterojunction morphologies and despite substantial fractions of weak-CT components. Here, using Y6 as a model non-fullerene acceptor (NFA) system, we show that structurally distinct aggregates coexisting in NFA thin films possess complementary CT characters, which are expected to enable directional energy transfer and enhanced exciton delocalization. We establish a general multi-component FRET framework that quantitatively links molecular aggregation, CT character, and excited-state dynamics in systems with multiple packing motifs. This work provides insight into the development of next-generation high-performance organic electronic materials and devices.

AI.tldr: Y6薄膜中结构不同聚集体间的互补CT特征介导亚皮秒FRET（效率65%），解释同质结有机光伏的高EQE。
AI.motivation: Y6基同质结有机光伏效率突出，但其长激子扩散与高效激子解离的微观机制仍存争议。
AI.method: 利用超快光谱表征Y6薄膜中聚集体间能量转移，并以Y6为模型非富勒烯受体建立多组分FRET框架，定量关联分子聚集、CT特征与激发态动力学。
AI.result: 发现结构不同的Y6聚集体具有互补CT特征，可发生定向能量转移并增强激子离域；聚集体间FRET集合平均效率达65%，发生在亚皮秒时间尺度（<1 ps），驱动Y6薄膜长程能量迁移，并解释无传统给受体本体异质结形貌及存在大量弱CT组分时同质结器件仍具高EQE。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示NFA薄膜多堆积motif中FRET介导的能量迁移机制，建立可普适关联聚集结构、CT特征和激发态动力学的框架，为高性能有机电子材料与器件设计提供依据。

title: Kagome Flat Bands from Self-Assembled Water on Non-van der Waals 2D Materials
summary: The properties of two-dimensional (2D) materials are governed not only by their intrinsic electronic structure but also in particular by their surface chemistry and interactions with the environment. The surfaces of non-van der Waals (non-vdW) 2D materials are intrinsically reactive and may require chemical stabilization under realistic experimental conditions. Here, we perform a systematic first-principles study of water passivation of non-vdW 2D materials and demonstrate that molecular water adsorption is energetically and dynamically favored for a wide range of systems. Rather than dissociating, water molecules frequently remain intact and form adsorbed ordered surface overlayers. These overlayers can adopt a kagome lattice geometry, leading to the emergence of flat electronic bands directly at the valence-band edge. Analysis of the electronic structure reveals a strong intermolecular coupling between neighboring water lone pairs within this kagome topology, while the locked molecular orientations simultaneously produce an electrostatically frustrated surface potential. These findings establish water not only as a stabilizing agent but also as an active element for electronic structure engineering of non-vdW 2D surfaces.

AI.tldr: 该文通过第一性原理计算表明，水分子可在多种非范德华二维材料表面稳定吸附并形成有序覆盖层，且可诱导Kagome晶格与价带边平带，从而实现表面电子结构调控。
AI.motivation: 非范德华二维材料表面本征反应性强，在实际实验条件下可能需要化学钝化；因此需要系统理解水等环境分子对其表面的稳定化作用及电子结构影响。
AI.method: 开展系统性第一性原理研究，评估分子态水吸附在广泛非范德华二维材料体系中的能量与动力学可行性，并分析吸附覆盖层的几何构型与电子结构。
AI.result: 分子态水吸附在能量和动力学上广泛有利；水常保持完整而不解离，形成有序表面覆盖层，并可采取Kagome晶格几何，在价带边产生平带。其电子结构源于Kagome拓扑中相邻水孤对电子间的强分子间耦合，同时锁定分子取向造成静电挫败的表面势。
AI.conclusion: 水不仅是非范德华二维表面的稳定剂，还可作为主动元素用于电子结构工程，通过有序水覆盖层调控表面电子态。

title: Quantum Embedding from Molecular to Crystalline Environments at the Cost of a Gas-Phase Calculation
summary: We present a direct-space formulation and implementation of quantum density functional theory (DFT) embedding for molecular active subsystems embedded in frozen environments (hosts) of arbitrary dimensionality, from finite molecular hosts to extended systems. The host is computed once without the embedded molecule (the guest) and is represented only by its electron density fitted in an atom-centered auxiliary Gaussian basis together with its nuclear charges with the periodic electrostatics separated into an explicit near-field and a continuous fast-multipole far-field operator. The method allows the removal of host atoms from this representation to create vacancies or other voids without requiring a supercell creation. Analytic nuclear gradients are also implemented, enabling structural relaxation of the active subsystem. We demonstrate the versatility of the approach through applications to adsorbates on periodic surfaces and molecules embedded in bulk solvent environments. For CO on MgO(001), we show that DFT-in-DFT converges rapidly and reproduces the periodic interaction energy within 0.44 kJ/mol while reducing the cost by a factor of 27. Real-time time-dependent embedded DFT (RT-TDDFET) of methylenecyclopropene in periodic water is showcased to produce a ~0.6 eV solvatochromic blue shift, while strong-field propagation of CO2 on hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) yields substrate-induced effects at the cost of a gas-phase propagation. Coupling the embedding scheme to excited-state correlated wave function theory methods such as CC2 yields a solvent shift within 0.01 eV of supermolecular CC2 references, while reducing the computational cost by over 500 times.

AI.tldr: 提出直接空间 DFT 嵌入框架，将分子活性区嵌入冻结环境，支持任意维度宿主、无需超胞并含解析梯度，在表面与溶剂体系中实现近超分子精度和显著加速。
AI.motivation: 在保留周期/扩展环境密度与静电效应的同时降低大体系基态和激发态计算成本，避免超胞构建及宿主重复计算。
AI.method: 宿主一次性计算，仅以原子中心辅助高斯基拟合的电子密度和核电荷表示；周期静电分为显式近场与连续快速多极远场；可移除宿主原子形成空位；实现解析核梯度以弛豫活性区；可耦合 RT-TDDFT 和 CC2 等激发态方法。
AI.result: CO/MgO(001) 的 DFT-in-DFT 快速收敛，相互作用能误差 0.44 kJ/mol，成本降低 27 倍；周期水中亚甲基环丙烯的 RT-TDDFET 给出约 0.6 eV 溶剂化蓝移；hBN 上 CO2 强场传播显示基底诱导效应；耦合 CC2 的溶剂移与超分子参考相差 0.01 eV 内，成本降低超过 500 倍。
AI.conclusion: 该嵌入方法适用于周期表面、体相溶剂及强场激发态等场景，兼具近超分子精度与显著计算加速，为扩展环境中分子活性区的 DFT 与相关波函数计算提供了通用高效方案。

title: Lattice dynamical properties and interatomic force constants of transition metal oxide perovskite superlattices
summary: In this study, we investigate the construction of efficient model potentials for perovskite heterostructures by transferring relevant dynamic quantities from bulk systems and short-period superlattices. Through first-principles calculations, we provide a comprehensive analysis and comparison of the dynamical properties of different perovskite-based superlattice structures, including (PbTiO3 )n /(SrTiO3 )m superlattices, (ATiO3 )n /(AO) 2 superlattices, and An+1 Tin O 3n+1 Ruddlesden-Popper phases, where A can be Sr, Ba, or Pb. We demonstrate that as the thickness of these structures increases, the dynamical properties of the perovskite blocks converge rapidly towards their bulk counterparts. We discuss this convergence in terms of phonon density of states in reciprocal space and inter-atomic force constants in real space. Our findings suggest a straightforward strategy for developing transferable model potentials that accurately capture the dynamics of layered oxide compounds with progressively thicker layers.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理研究钙钛矿异质结构动力学性质随层厚收敛到体相的行为，提出构建可迁移高效模型势的策略。
AI.motivation: 为钙钛矿异质结构建立高效模型势，并利用体相和短周期超晶格中的动力学量实现迁移。
AI.method: 用第一性原理计算比较(PbTiO3)n/(SrTiO3)m超晶格、(ATiO3)n/(AO)2超晶格及An+1TinO3n+1 Ruddlesden-Popper相的动力学性质，并从倒空间声子态密度和实空间原子间力常数分析收敛性。
AI.result: 随结构厚度增加，钙钛矿块的动力学性质快速收敛至其体相对应性质。
AI.conclusion: 该收敛行为支持一种直接策略：从体相和短周期超晶格迁移动力学量，构建能准确描述逐层增厚层状氧化物动力学的可迁移模型势。

title: Revealing laser-induced modification of weak ferromagnetism through a spin-reorientation phase transition in iron borate Fe$_3$BO$_6$
summary: In the iron oxide Fe$_3$BO$_6$ weak ferromagnetism stems from competing contributions from two-site Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions (DMI) and from on-site anisotropies at the two $4c$ and $8d$ types of nonequivalent Fe$^{3+}$ sites. As a result, spin reorientation (SR) transition $\Gamma_2$ $\rightarrow$ $\Gamma_4$ in Fe$_3$BO$_6$ uniquely comprises 90$^\circ$ spin switching and a 35% change of weak ferromagnetic moment. We explore ultrafast kinetics of such a transition as a proxy for weak ferromagnetism contributions modified by femtosecond laser pulses. Using magneto-optical pump-probe technique we reveal that the SR transition is triggered by an abrupt decrease of the weak ferromagnetic moment in the $\Gamma_2$ phase, and relate it to the laser-induced modification of the DMI and anisotropy contributions to the spin canting. By tuning the pump pulse phonon energy between different optical absorption ranges, we show that laser-driven impact on spin canting possesses a nonthermal character and is achieved through the charge-transfer transitions $2p\rightarrow3d$ within Fe$^{3+}$O$^{2-}_6$ octahedra rather than by localized $3d\rightarrow3d$ transitions at Fe$^{3+}$. The decreased weak ferromagnetic moment controls the threshold and the latency of the SR transition, as well as a final state. The latter is achieved via the precessional switching to the $\Gamma_4$ phase activated by the laser-induced heating. Final state is found to be a coexistence of $\Gamma_4$ and $\Gamma_2$ phase with modified spin canting persisting even at hundreds of picoseconds.

AI.tldr: 飞秒激光可通过Fe3+O6八面体内的电荷转移跃迁非热地改变Fe3BO6中DMI与各向异性对自旋倾斜的贡献，从而触发Γ2→Γ4自旋重取向，并形成持续数百皮秒的Γ4/Γ2共存态。
AI.motivation: Fe3BO6的弱铁磁性源于两个非等价Fe3+位点（4c和8d）上双位点Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）与在位各向异性的竞争；其Γ2→Γ4自旋重取向包含90°自旋翻转和35%弱铁磁矩变化，是研究弱铁磁贡献超快调控的理想载体。
AI.method: 采用磁光泵浦-探测技术研究Γ2→Γ4自旋重取向的超快动力学，并通过调节泵浦脉冲能量至不同光吸收区间，区分局域3d→3d跃迁与Fe3+O6八面体内2p→3d电荷转移跃迁的作用。
AI.result: 自旋重取向由Γ2相弱铁磁矩的突然降低触发，该降低与激光诱导的DMI和各向异性对自旋倾斜贡献的改变相关；该过程具有非热特征，主要由Fe3+O6八面体内的2p→3d电荷转移跃迁驱动，而非Fe3+的局域3d→3d跃迁。弱铁磁矩降低控制自旋重取向的阈值、延迟和最终态；最终态通过激光诱导加热激活的进动翻转进入Γ4相，并表现为Γ4与Γ2相共存且自旋倾斜被修改，持续至数百皮秒。
AI.conclusion: 超快自旋重取向由电荷转移跃迁非热调控自旋倾斜及弱铁磁矩实现；弱铁磁矩的瞬态降低决定转变阈值、潜伏期和终态，而激光加热驱动的进动翻转导致Γ4/Γ2共存终态。

title: Schottky barrier height modulation and memristive behavior in a mechanically exfoliated $MoS_2$ flake with multiple lateral electrodes
summary: Van de Waals materials possess great potential as core active materials for novel electronics, optoelectronics, and sensing applications. In particular, transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) and other low-dimensional materials, such as hexagonal boron nitride and binary oxides exhibit memristive behavior, making them attractive candidates as building blocks for resistive memories and neuromorphic computing devices. In this work, we investigate two-terminal lateral memristors based on mechanically exfoliated few layer $MoS_2$ flakes. We study the influence of the Schottky barrier height (SBH) as a function of the contact area. We report different SBHs from 60 meV up to 208 meV in the same $MoS_2$ flake and analyze the effect of the SBH in the memristive-like $J-V_{DS}$ curves and the observed non-volatile/volatile resistance switching. Our results highlight the importance of contact engineering to obtain different memristive properties in $MoS_2$-based devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于机械剥离少层MoS2制备两端横向忆阻器，发现接触面积可调控肖特基势垒高度（60–208 meV），并影响其忆阻型J-V特性及非易失/易失阻变行为。
AI.motivation: TMDs、h-BN和二元氧化物等低维材料具有忆阻行为，是阻变存储器和神经形态计算的潜在构建单元；需理解接触与肖特基势垒对MoS2忆阻器件性能的影响。
AI.method: 制备基于机械剥离少层MoS2薄片的横向两端忆阻器，改变接触面积并提取肖特基势垒高度（SBH），分析SBH对J-VDS曲线及阻变行为的作用。
AI.result: 在同一MoS2薄片中观察到SBH从60 meV至208 meV变化；SBH差异与忆阻样J-V曲线以及非易失/易失电阻切换相关。
AI.conclusion: 接触工程对调控MoS2基器件的忆阻特性至关重要，可实现不同忆阻性能。

title: Quantum benchmarks for magnetic energies and transition temperatures
summary: Predicting magnetic ordering temperatures requires accurate exchange interactions and an appropriate treatment of spin thermodynamics. Here we assess these requirements through complementary quantum Monte Carlo benchmarks. For five insulating antiferromagnets, we compare ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic energy differences from diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) and density functional theory with references reconstructed from inelastic neutron scattering (INS) exchanges. DMC underestimates these references but achieves a mean absolute error comparable to the best-performing functionals tested. Separately, we directly test the previously proposed (S+1)/S rescaling of classical Monte Carlo temperatures against quantum stochastic series expansion simulations for 17 compounds using corresponding INS-derived Heisenberg Hamiltonians. Rescaling reduces the mean absolute classical-quantum temperature difference from 81.7 to 8.2 K, with a mean absolute percentage difference of 5.9 %. These results establish a direct quantum benchmark for the rescaling within the tested models and emphasize that improvements in electronic magnetic energy scales should be accompanied by attention to quantum spin thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 该文用扩散蒙特卡洛、密度泛函理论和量子随机级数展开，分别基准检验磁交换能与经典蒙特卡洛温度重标度，发现DMC交换能虽有低估但误差可与最佳泛函相比，(S+1)/S重标度可显著降低经典-量子温度偏差。
AI.motivation: 预测磁有序温度需要准确的交换相互作用和恰当的量子自旋热力学处理，作者评估这两项要求。
AI.method: 对5个绝缘反铁磁体，将DMC与DFT得到的铁磁-反铁磁能量差同由非弹性中子散射交换参数重建的参考值比较；另对17个化合物，用基于INS-derived Heisenberg哈密顿量的量子随机级数展开检验先前提出的经典Monte Carlo温度(S+1)/S重标度。
AI.result: DMC低估INS参考交换能，但其平均绝对误差与测试中最佳泛函相当；(S+1)/S重标度将经典-量子平均绝对温度差从81.7 K降至8.2 K，平均绝对百分比差为5.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在所测试模型中为(S+1)/S重标度提供了直接量子基准，并强调改进电子磁能标的同时需重视量子自旋热力学。

title: Harmonic origin of local symmetry breaking in PbTe revealed using machine-learned potentials
summary: We use machine-learned interatomic potentials combined with higher-order interatomic force constant models to show that finite-range polar correlations in PbTe are driven by long-range harmonic interactions rather than lattice anharmonicity. Our molecular dynamics simulations reveal a spatial polar correlation range exceeding 50 {\AA} at low temperatures and decreasing with increasing temperature. Selective interatomic force constant mapping demonstrates that crystal anharmonicity usually associated with the formation of polar nanoregions suppresses polar correlations. Instead, long-range harmonic interactions extending to 13 {\AA} are necessary to reproduce the spatial coherence of local dipoles. In reciprocal space, these extended harmonic interactions correspond to high curvature of the transverse optical (TO) phonon branch at the $\Gamma$ point. Comparison with isostructural NaCl connects these extended interactions to local underscreening of predominantly Coulombic forces. Our results provide a key microscopic description of finite-range polar correlations and a framework for understanding local symmetry breaking in centrosymmetric materials.

AI.tldr: PbTe中的有限程极性关联由长程谐波相互作用驱动，而非晶格非谐性。
AI.motivation: 厘清中心对称材料中局域对称性破缺与有限程极性关联的微观起源，特别是区分晶格非谐性与长程谐波相互作用的作用。
AI.method: 结合机器学习原子间势与高阶原子间力常数模型，开展分子动力学模拟、选择性力常数映射和倒空间声子分析，并与同构NaCl比较。
AI.result: 低温柔性极性关联范围超过50 Å并随温度升高而减小；通常与极性纳米区相关的非谐性反而抑制极性关联，需引入延伸至13 Å的长程谐波相互作用才能再现局域偶极的空间相干性；倒空间中该作用对应Γ点TO声子支的高曲率，并与 predominantly Coulombic 力的局域欠屏蔽有关。
AI.conclusion: 有限程极性关联主要由长程谐波相互作用而非晶格非谐性决定，为理解中心对称材料中的局域对称性破缺提供了微观框架。

title: GibbScope: interactive calculation and visualization of phase diagrams in the browser
summary: Phase diagrams are a constant work in progress as Gibbs-energy models are fitted, revised, and disputed in the light of an endless stream of experimental and computational data. Yet, phase diagrams are still largely communicated as static figures, in much the same way as a century ago. We present GibbScope, a web-based framework for interactive calculation and visualization of binary phase diagrams. Written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly, the new CALPHAD engine recomputes a complete phase diagram in the browser in a fraction of a second with zero installation on the user or server side. The high speed allows new ways of interacting with phase diagrams and underlying assessments. Validation against well-established CALPHAD software shows agreement to within 0.01 K for invariant temperatures and within 1e-6 for tie-line compositions for most databases. GibbScope offers interactive CALPHAD parameter adjustments, overlays of different assessments and point-by-point misfit to experimental data, which makes the diagram a live, working object. In addition, GibbScope provides convenient access to 2745 thermodynamic databases from the SGTE collection (Hallstedt, 2025) and their live adjustment. For over 1200 of these databases, all phases are modeled in full with the current implementation.

AI.tldr: GibbScope 是一个基于 Rust/WebAssembly 的浏览器端 CALPHAD 框架，可交互计算并可视化二元相图，在无安装条件下亚秒级重算完整相图。
AI.motivation: 相图仍多以静态图形式发布，而 Gibbs 能模型持续被拟合、修订和争议；需要让相图及底层评估成为可交互、可实时更新的“活对象”。
AI.method: 作者开发 GibbScope：用 Rust 编写并编译为 WebAssembly 的 CALPHAD 引擎，在浏览器中重算完整二元相图；支持交互式调整 CALPHAD 参数、叠加不同评估、逐点显示与实验数据的偏差，并接入 SGTE 热力学数据库。
AI.result: 与成熟 CALPHAD 软件验证显示，多数数据库的不变温度一致到 0.01 K 以内，联结线成分一致到 1e-6 以内；提供 2745 个 SGTE 数据库访问，其中超过 1200 个数据库的所有相均可在当前实现中完整建模。
AI.conclusion: GibbScope 将相图从静态图转变为可交互计算与调整的工作对象，提升了 CALPHAD 的可访问性、验证效率和数据库复用能力。

title: Out-of-plane interference effects in the angle-resolved photoemission of epitaxial graphene
summary: The epitaxial growth of monolayer graphene by Si sublimation of 6H-SiC(0001) is one of the most effective ways of producing large-scale monocrystalline graphene samples of high quality. However, graphene is left interacting with a reconstructed carbon buffer layer known as zerolayer graphene (ZLG) and the SiC substrate underneath. Beyond the mere creation of Dirac cone replicas, the effect of this interaction on photoemission measurements is poorly understood. We utilized synchrotron radiation for photon-energy-dependent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) to investigate the complex final-state interactions of photoelectrons within the heterostructure of monolayer graphene, ZLG, and SiC. We identify multiple resonances in the photoemission intensity of the Dirac cone as a function of photon energy that originate from interlayer interference, confirmed with a multiple scattering model. We also demonstrate for the first time that the relative intensity of the replica bands induced by the $(6\sqrt{3} \times 6\sqrt{3})\text{R}30^\circ$ reconstruction scales with the electron kinetic energy. Finally, we resolved four nondispersing electronic states, which originate from the ZLG. Our findings show that the three-dimensional (3D) structure of SiC and ZLG manifests itself in the photoemission from two-dimensional (2D) epitaxial graphene. By revealing how 3D substrate architecture dictates the photoemission of a 2D layer, this work establishes a crucial framework for investigating the electronic structure of complex heterostructures via ARPES.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用光子能量依赖的同步辐射ARPES，揭示SiC(0001)上外延单层石墨烯与零层石墨烯（ZLG）/SiC衬底之间的三维终态相互作用如何显著影响二维石墨烯的光电子发射。
AI.motivation: SiC升华外延可制备高质量大面积单晶石墨烯，但石墨烯与重构碳缓冲层ZLG及SiC衬底强耦合；除Dirac锥复制带外，这种异质结构对光电子能谱测量的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用同步辐射光子能量依赖的角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）研究单层石墨烯/ZLG/SiC异质结构中的光电子终态相互作用，并用多重散射模型确认层间干涉机制。
AI.result: 在Dirac锥光电子强度随光子能量的变化中观察到多个由层间干涉导致的共振；首次证明(6√3×6√3)R30°重构诱导的复制带相对强度随电子动能缩放；分辨出四个来源于ZLG的非色散电子态。
AI.conclusion: SiC与ZLG的三维结构会体现在二维外延石墨烯的光电子发射中；该工作阐明了三维衬底结构对二维层ARPES谱的影响，为复杂异质结构电子结构研究提供了关键框架。

title: Finite temperature and pressure structural relaxations including zero-point motion and anharmonicity
summary: At finite temperature and pressure, the equilibrium structure of a crystal minimizes the Gibbs free energy rather than the static Born-Oppenheimer energy. We present WARP (Wyckoff-constrained Anharmonic Relaxations at Pressure and temperature), a symmetry-constrained, variable-cell relaxation based on the stochastic temperature-dependent effective potential method, including anharmonicity and zero-point motion. Every position update is projected onto Wyckoff positions and every strain onto symmetric strains, so a relaxation can raise the symmetry but never lower it. For aluminum, the thermal expansion follows measurements at cryogenic temperatures, including the quantum plateau below 50 K. For lanthanum hydrides at megabar pressures, equations of state agree with phonon-based and path-integral calculations, and LaH$_{10}$ relaxes from its rhombohedral static minimum to the observed cubic phase, also with a machine-learned potential fine-tuned on 150 supercells. For brucite, Mg(OD)$_2$, lattice parameters, bond distances and thermal expansion agree with neutron diffraction, and the O-D isotope effect is captured.

AI.tldr: 提出 WARP：一种基于随机温度相关有效势、保持/提升对称性的变胞弛豫方法，用于有限温度与压力下晶体的 Gibbs 自由能极小化，并考虑非谐性与零点运动。
AI.motivation: 晶体在有限温压下的平衡结构由 Gibbs 自由能决定，而非静态 Born-Oppenheimer 能量；现有弛豫常忽略温度、非谐性、零点运动及对称性约束。
AI.method: WARP 采用随机温度相关有效势方法（stochastic TDEP）进行对称约束的变胞弛豫；每次位置更新投影到 Wyckoff 位置，每次应变更新投影到对称应变，因此弛豫只能提高而不会降低对称性，并包含非谐性与零点运动。
AI.result: 对铝，热膨胀与低温测量一致，包括 50 K 以下量子平台；对兆巴压力下镧氢化物，状态方程与声子及路径积分计算一致，LaH10 从菱方静态极小弛豫到实验观测立方相，并用在 150 个超胞上微调的机器学习势验证；对 Mg(OD)2 氢氧镁石，晶格参数、键长和热膨胀与中子衍射一致，并捕捉 O-D 同位素效应。
AI.conclusion: WARP 可实现有限温压下保持对称性的预测性结构弛豫，适用于包含量子效应、非谐性和高压条件等多种材料体系。

title: High Pressure Material Phase Identification with Gaussian Kernel Neural Networks
summary: Phase identification is a computational task involving the classification of material structure using the positions of atoms. Using data from Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, our task is to identify the material phase of a set of atoms, based on how the simulations predict their positioning relative to each other. By leveraging existing research on mechanistic neural network theory, particularly Neural Tangent Kernels (NTK), we develop a new and efficient method for classifying simulated material samples. Our method involves defining a set of "atom detectors" that are given positions around the origin in cartesian coordinates. The sum of Gaussians centered at each atom is calculated at each atom detector, and is used as the input to a neural network. We present theoretical and experimental evidence to show that this method is highly effective and efficient at the task. Our method obtains better or similar accuracy scores to commonly used methods while having a major computational speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于原子探测器和高斯求和输入神经网络的材料相识别方法，利用NTK理论提升分类效率。
AI.motivation: 利用分子动力学模拟中的原子相对位置进行材料相分类，同时降低传统方法在相识别任务中的计算成本。
AI.method: 在笛卡尔坐标原点周围设置一组“原子探测器”，在每个探测器处计算以各原子为中心的高斯函数之和，并将其作为神经网络输入进行分类；借助神经切线核（NTK）相关理论进行分析。
AI.result: 理论和实验表明该方法高效有效，在保持与常用方法相当或更优的准确率的同时实现显著计算加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种高效的材料相识别方法，说明基于原子探测器的高斯特征结合神经网络可在该任务中兼顾精度与计算效率。

title: Experimentally Grounded Machine Learning of PrecursorSurface-Reactant Chemistry in Atomic Layer Deposition
summary: Whether a precursor-substrate-reactant combination yields an atomic layer deposition (ALD) process is still settled by trial-and-error experiments. Here we introduce AJIN (ALD Joint Interpretable Network), a machine-learning framework that learns this decision from experimental outcomes. We compiled 560 experimentally observed ALD and area-selective ALD outcomes spanning 76 precursors, 27 substrates, 20 reactants and 25-620 degrees Celsius. Following the ALD cycle, AJIN predicts adsorption from graph-neural-network embeddings of the precursor and substrate with temperature, and deposition by adding the reactant. The best model (CHGNet-MLP) reaches balanced accuracies of 79.2% for adsorption and 84.8% for deposition and transfers partially to unseen precursors. SHAP and ablation analyses show that substrate chemistry governs adsorption, whereas precursor, substrate and reactant all contribute to deposition. Tested against our laboratory's ALD experiments, AJIN correctly predicted 83% of new-substrate cases and 71% of new precursor-substrate adsorption cases, providing an experimentally grounded tool for prioritizing ALD and area-selective ALD chemistries.

AI.tldr: AJIN 是一个基于实验数据训练的机器学习框架，用于判断前驱体-基底-反应物组合能否形成 ALD 或面积选择性 ALD 工艺。
AI.motivation: 目前 ALD 工艺可行性主要依赖试错实验，成本高且效率低，因此需要从已有实验结局中学习决策规则的工具。
AI.method: 作者汇编了 560 个实验观测的 ALD/面积选择性 ALD 结果，覆盖 76 种前驱体、27 种基底、20 种反应物和 25–620°C；AJIN 按 ALD 循环建模：先用前驱体与基底的图神经网络嵌入及温度预测吸附，再加入反应物预测沉积；最佳模型为 CHGNet-MLP，并用 SHAP 与消融分析解释特征贡献。
AI.result: 最佳模型在吸附和沉积上的平衡准确率分别为 79.2% 和 84.8%，并对未见前驱体具有一定迁移能力；SHAP 与消融显示基底化学主导吸附，而前驱体、基底和反应物共同影响沉积。实验室验证中，AJIN 对新基底案例预测正确率为 83%，对新前驱体-基底吸附案例为 71%。
AI.conclusion: AJIN 提供了有实验依据的 ALD 与面积选择性 ALD 化学体系优先级筛选工具，可减少试错实验并辅助新体系探索。

title: Pelletization Pressure Engineering of the Superconducting Properties of Fluorine-Doped PrFeAsO
summary: We investigate the influence of the pelletization pressure on the structural, microstructural, and superconducting properties of fluorine-doped PrFeAsO0.7F0.3 (Pr1111).
